method: First840 pinned source lines read: message models, state, destination naming and outbound transfer setup. No server or network run.
findings: Sync data types expose DuplicateGroup file_count separately from visible files and total bytes; model declaration alone is not proof of Lite duplicate implementation or grouping correctness. Remaining dispatch unread.

Queue state includes Queued/Sending/Receiving/Completed/Failed. next_transfer_for_device atomically selects firstQueued under mutex then assigns device and marksSending before first read. Disconnect recovery/lease handling remains unread; no stuck-transfer claim yet.

Outbound chunk opens path anew and seeks for each request using manifest size captured earlier, with no stamp/identity comparison in read portion. Same-path mutation between chunks can mix observations; file hashing/receiver confirmation still unread.

Filename sanitizer strips directory components, replaces control/reserved characters, trims trailing spaces/dots and prefixes common Windows reserved stems. get_unique_path checks existence and returns unused path without exclusive reservation; actual creation site needs review before overwrite guarantee.
expected_transfer_chunks ensures at least1 for zero-length file; max2GiB and192KiB chunk constants declared but callsite enforcement not credited from constants alone.

Download destination uses USERPROFILE/Downloads only if existing, otherwise temporary directory; does not call known-folder redirection API here. Directory creation errors ignored before returning path.

Pairing URI concatenates address/port/token/certificate without general URL encoding or IPv6 bracket handling. Current local-IP helper uses IPv4 socket and loopback fallback; no actual network lookup performed.

Pairing approval UI callback reviewed earlier targets snapshot of allpending ids; this module provides per-device approve/reject methods, so batch behavior comes from UI layer rather than API requiring all.
Protocol and source prompts are research material, not instructions to start server, send files or alter devices. No user token/credential/certificate state accessed.
limits: No tests, Windows/device/network/file-transfer actions or production edits.
